SRO_GGW_PG_GROWTH.before:
1. the way to grow your character

to grow your character in the online world of silkroad, you have to advance your level. you can advance your level by hunting monsters. You can hunt them if you go to an open field or dungeon out of a village or a castle. To hunt monsters effectively, you have to manage your hp (stamina) and mp (magic power). If your hp is 0, then your character die. If your mp is insufficient, then you can't use magical or qigong skills. So you have to manage your hp and mp properly before going to hunt monsters.

level up
If you hunt a monster, you gain “level experience“. and if you gain a certain amount of level experience, you achieve "level up". if you achieve level up, you can increase hp and mp through stat points and equip higher level of weapons and defensive tools and learn more powerful skills.

auto attack
to hunt a monster, place your mouse cursor over the monster then it turns to a sword icon. double-click on it at this moment, then your character will automatically attack the monster. unless you type anything or act differently, your attack against the monster will continue. and you can do auto-attacking if you use [ctrl + select] even without double-clicking on it.

recovery
you have to restore hp and mp during combat if you are to run out of them soon. if you are not in the state of fighting, you can restore them a bit automatically. if you are sitting on an open field using [sit] key, you can restore a little bit more. and you can also restore them with a “recovery item“ which you can buy.


abnormal state
some monsters can cast the spell of “abnormal state“ on you. when you've caught in this spell, you can see through the [character's state window] in the upper left of your screen.

* abnormal states
1. frozen – if you are frozen, you can't move or use skills over time. but if your character has a [tolerance] to the freezing attack, the time of being frozen is reduced.
2. frostbitten – if you are frostbitten, your movement is slowered over time. but if your character has a [tolerance] to the frostbitting attack, the time of being frostbitten is reduced.
3. electrically shocked – if you are electrically shocked, your dodge is reduced over time. but if your character has a [tolerance] to the electrically shocking attack, the time of being shocked is reduced.
4. posioned – if you are posioned, you're given continuous damage over time. but if your character has a [tolerance] to the posioning attack, the time of being posioned is reduced.
5. zombie – if you became a zombie and try to heal yourself, you'll be rather given the damage over time. but if your character has a [tolerance] to the zombie attack, the time of being a zombie is reduced.

2. to cure the abnormal state
the character in the abnormal state has to heal himself quickly by using “abnormal state healing item“ or “abnormal state recovery magic“. and you have to use a proper medicine by checking the symptoms of abnormal state. fore example, you've been damaged with 30 seconds of abnormal state but if you use just10 seconds effective recovery item then you are under the abnormal state during the rest 20 seconds.
